analogue: Irradiation of particle-bound peroxides and other chromophores in α-pinene ozonolysis SOA, followed by loss of volatile products.
citation: Direct Photolysis of α-Pinene Ozonolysis Secondary Organic Aerosol: Effect on Particle Mass and Peroxide Content
evidence: Near-UV irradiation of denuded particles depleted organic peroxides; the inferred particle-diameter loss was 0.56% per day under the authors' solar scaling.
difference: The experiment did not measure one fragmentation coefficient for every particle constituent. Its lamp, peroxide abundance and exposure differ from the illuminated Manchester mixture.
